title: Budapest Pride planned car demonstration against anti-LGBTQ legislative package
reason: Organizers planned at most 30 participants, but police prohibited the demonstration on Dec 7 under the assembly ban; it did not occur.

title: Mayors’ coordinated municipal decorative-lights shutdown
reason: The announced protest consisted of cities switching off municipal festive lighting; no public gathering or participants are evidenced. Search-result reporting says the light-off happened.

title: Opposition banner on Chain Bridge opposing government policy toward Budapest
reason: RTL reports five activists; below the 50-person threshold. Police removed the banner and initiated curfew proceedings.
